subject: Seattle workshop — mobility plan & exec car services
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marco Santos <ops@seattlelimo.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Seattle workshop — mobility plan & exec car services

Folks —

We have the Acme Corp enterprise workshop at the Hotel Olympia on Nov 20–21 and need to lock ground mobility this week. High-level asks:

- Executive car service for three VIPs arriving evening of Nov 19 (pickup at SEA-TAC) — meet & greet preferred, luggage assistance.
- Day-of rides for on-site execs between hotel, workshop venue (15 min away), and pre-event dinner (short hops).
- 2 rental vans for workshop leads to move equipment between hotel and satellite lab.
- Reserved hotel parking for 12 vehicles (self-park) and 3 dedicated marked exec spots.
- Rideshare credit setup (Uber/Lyft) for 40 attendees with a single billing account.

Marco — can SeattleLimo provide: meet & greet for the three exec pickups, a daytime dispatch lead, and an on-call hybrid sedan for late departures? Please attach standard rates and a sample itinerary.

Budget target: keep exec car rates under $250/leg where possible; rental vans to be competitive. If there are any price breaks for multi-day coverage, call them out.

Attached: draft itinerary and what I discussed with Acme events.

Thanks — Vivek

[attachment: exec_pickup_sample-itinerary.txt]
From: Marco Santos <ops@seattlelimo.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Seattle workshop — mobility plan & exec car services

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the details. We can cover the full scope. Quick summary of availability and options:

1) Executive pickups (Nov 19 arrivals): Meet & greet + black sedan (Lincoln/Toyota Avalon class) — $225 per pickup, 45-minute hold included. If you prefer SUVs, $280.
2) Daytime fleet: Dedicated dispatch (on-site) from 7:00–18:00 each day, plus one on-call hybrid for evenings. Dispatch lead is $65/hr.
3) Rental vans: We partner with ZoomCar Rentals for 12-passenger cargo vans — $165/day (plus insurance).
4) Parking: We can coordinate blocked self-park stalls with Hotel Olympia; will need a hotel contact to finalize.
5) Rideshare credits: We can provide a pre-paid rideshare billing solution via corporate account setup (billing to Redwood) — needs a 7-business-day setup window.

Attached are our standard fleet rates and a sample run-of-show.

Questions for you:
- Exact arrival windows for the three execs (flight numbers if you have them).
- Do you want a dedicated greeter at baggage claim or curbside only?

Best,
Marco Santos
Operations Manager
SeattleLimo
[attachment: fleet_rates_seattle_2026.pdf]
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marco Santos <ops@seattlelimo.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Seattle workshop — mobility plan & exec car services

Quick notes —

- Exec arrivals: tentative flights below (will confirm 11/16):
  • VIP A — AA 742, ETA 20:45 (SEA)
  • VIP B — DL 1193, ETA 21:10 (SEA)
  • VIP C — AS 412, ETA 22:05 (SEA)

- Please plan for curbside greeters with contact numbers that the VIPs can call if baggage delays happen.
- Rentals: we only need 2 x 12-passenger vans for Nov 20 (full day) and Nov 21 (morning pickup).
- Parking: hotel contact is Emily Zhao (events@hotelolympia.com) — looping her in for a parking map and to confirm the 3 exec spots.

Marco — can you confirm driver names will be provided in advance and that vehicles will have Redwood branding signage available (small magnet signs) so the VIPs can identify cars?

Thanks — Monica

All —

This looks good. A couple of policy notes from finance/security:

- Carded billing to Redwood is fine (we'll get an expense code for the event). Please ensure SeattleLimo provides an itemized invoice (per pickup, per hour, per van).
- For after-hours transport (after 23:00) for staff, please require driver check-ins and share driver IDs. Exec rides can have looser rules but keep a list of assigned drivers.
- If any vendor needs access to the hotel's loading dock, they must be escorted by hotel staff (Emily will handle).

Monica — please confirm whether rideshare credits should be loaded at check-in or emailed day-of. If emailed day-of, include instructions for redemption.

-Rishi

Looping in final vendor asks and next steps:

- Marco: please send contract/statement of work (SOW) and itemized estimate so procurement can route for sign-off. DocuSign preferred.
- Marco / ZoomCar: confirm vehicle make/plate or temporary reservation IDs and driver contact numbers by EOD 11/18.
- Monica: please confirm whether we load rideshare credits at registration (preferred) or distribute via email. I recommend registration so attendees get them on arrival.
- Vivek: approve the $2,800 not-to-exceed mobility budget for the event (covers exec transfers, vans, dispatch, and rideshare credits). If approved, I'll cut the purchase order.

Thanks — Marcus
